_methodology: Hand-annotated by visual inspection of data/pid/diagram.pdf page 1 (V-745 NGL Stabilizer / P-745 Submersible Sump Pump sheet) rendered at 150 DPI, cropped into four overlapping quadrants for legibility. Built as a second real test page beyond page 0's ground truth. Honest limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: unlike the CV shape detections elsewhere in this project (each individually tight-rendered and visually confirmed), these tags were read from quadrant-level crops without per-tag zoom verification -- several loop-number suffixes on this sheet (the DPI/DPIT/TI/TW instrument tags) have an ambiguous last character that could read as either 'S' or '5' at this resolution, the same digit-mangling problem documented for OCR on this exact document (see README 'Title-block cross-check'). Tags with that ambiguity are excluded rather than guessed -- see excluded_uncertain below. Not a claim of exhaustiveness.
excluded_uncertain: DPI/DPIT loop tags on the two 5-valve manifolds (approx '745-14S'/'745-145' and '745-13S'/'745-135') -- last character of the loop suffix is ambiguous between 'S' and '5' at 150 DPI, not confidently legible.
TIT/TW loop tags near the top-right vapor line (approx '745-15S'/'745-151') -- same S-vs-5 ambiguity.
TI/TW loop tags near the reboiler feed line (approx '745-13S'/'745-130') -- same S-vs-5 ambiguity.
A small square 'TI' instrument near the vapor recovery line (top-right quadrant) has a loop number too small to confidently read at this crop resolution -- excluded rather than guessed.
